record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Can one construct a functor from the category of Calabi-Yau manifolds to the category of N=2 vertex operator superalgebras such that the Fermat quintic threefold maps to the N=2 vertex operator superalgebra for the Gepner model and deformations of Calabi-Yau manifolds correspond to deformations of N=2 superconformal field theories?

evidence.quote: To study these conjectures using the representation theory of vertex operator algebras, the first step is to construct the corresponding N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras, that is, vertex operator algebras with N = 2 superconformal structures.

Problem 8.1. Construct a functor from the category of Calabi-Yau manifolds to the category of N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras such that the Fermat quintic threefold corresponds to the N = 2 vertex operator superalgebra for the Gepner model and such that deformations of Calabi-Yau manifolds correspond to deformations of N = 2 superconformal field theories.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{CY}$ denote the category whose objects are Calabi-Yau manifolds (compact Kähler manifolds with vanishing first Chern class, equipped with a Ricci-flat Kähler metric) and whose morphisms are an appropriate notion of Calabi-Yau morphisms. Let $\mathcal{V}_{N=2}$ denote the category whose objects are vertex operator superalgebras endowed with an $N=2$ superconformal structure (i.e. a representation of the $N=2$ super-Virasoro algebra by fields whose modes act on the underlying super vector space, compatible with the vertex algebra structure), and whose morphisms are vertex superalgebra homomorphisms preserving the $N=2$ structure.

Construct a functor 
$$F : \mathcal{CY} \longrightarrow \mathcal{V}_{N=2}$$
satisfying both of the following properties:

(1) The Fermat quintic threefold $\{[z_0:\dots:z_4]\in\mathbb{P}^4 : z_0^5+z_1^5+z_2^5+z_3^5+z_4^5=0\}$ is sent by $F$ to the $N=2$ vertex operator superalgebra underlying the Gepner model $(k=3)^{\otimes 5}$ (the GSO-projected tensor product of five copies of the $N=2$ minimal model at level $k=3$).

(2) Deformations of a Calabi-Yau manifold $X$ (in the sense of complex-structure and Kähler-class deformations) correspond, via $F$, to deformations of the associated $N=2$ superconformal field theory (i.e. to deformations of the $N=2$ vertex operator superalgebra $F(X)$ within $\mathcal{V}_{N=2}$).
artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator superalgebras and Calabi-Yau geometry
artifact.status_search_result: Partial constructions exist (e.g. the chiral de Rham complex of Malikov–Schechtman–Vaintrob attaches a sheaf of vertex superalgebras to a complex manifold, and Ben-Zvi–Heluani–Szczesny and Heluani showed that a Ricci-flat Kähler metric induces an N=2 superconformal structure on its global sections of the twisted chiral de Rham complex). However, no construction is known that simultaneously assigns to the Fermat quintic the Gepner model VOSA and realizes Calabi-Yau deformations as N=2 SCFT deformations in a functorial way. The problem is generally regarded as open.

status_evidence.title: Superconformal Structures on Generalized Calabi-Yau Metric Manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: An embedding of two commuting copies of the N=2 superconformal vertex algebra in the space of global sections of the twisted chiral-anti-chiral de Rham complex of a generalized Calabi-Yau metric manifold is constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Partial constructions of N=2 superconformal structures from Calabi-Yau geometry exist via the chiral de Rham complex.

status_evidence.title: Superconformal structures on generalized Calabi-Yau metric manifolds (arXiv:1006.2773)
status_evidence.snippet: A Riemannian metric on a complex manifold induces an N=1 superconformal structure on the global sections of the chiral de Rham complex, promoted to an N=2 structure if the metric is Kähler and Ricci-flat.
status_evidence.claim: Local/partial pieces of a functor from CY to N=2 VOSAs are known but the full conjectural functor with the Gepner matching is not established.

status_evidence.title: supersymmetry and Calabi-Yau manifolds in nLab
status_evidence.snippet: Gepner conjectured that all exact N=2 superconformal models correspond to Calabi-Yau manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: The Gepner-model/Calabi-Yau correspondence remains conjectural at the level of a full functor.
